_comment: OAuth providers for mail accounts (oauth-core.js, Docs/EMAIL-MODERNIZATION-PLAN.md). brokerApp names the app at the broker, which holds the client id and secret; nothing secret is here. templateId is the account type the sign-in makes; mail is the account's server settings.

microsoft.title: Microsoft
microsoft._mail: IMAP and SMTP, for personal accounts (Outlook.com). The account type is hidden from Add Account: the broker falls back to this app when Microsoft refuses Exchange's scope.

microsoft365.title: Microsoft Outlook
microsoft365._mail: Exchange ActiveSync, on Palm's mojomail-eas through libce-mailshim.so's adapters. Work and school accounts; a personal one comes back from the broker as microsoft.
